newsitem.title: USA: Struthers acquires WinCom for stock.
newsitem.headline: Struthers acquires WinCom for stock.

text.p: Struthers Industries Inc said Friday it had acquired Wincom Corp, a communications firm formerly called World Integrated Network of Cos Inc.
Struthers swapped 138,480,856 of its pre-split common shares. Struthers will pay 13 million shares at the deal's closing and the rest when it boosts its common authorization.
Struthers said it plans a .425-to-1 reverse stock split, an increase in the number of outstanding shares to 98 million and a decrease in the common stock par value to $0.01.
Following the deal, Winco Corp will own over 90 percent of Struthers common. Struthers will change names to Wincom Corp.
